description.zh: 需要绑定的输出OSS Bucket名称，支持中英文、数字、中划线（-），不能以特殊符号开头，不超过64个字节。
description.en: The name of the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket that you want to bind. The name can be up to 64 bytes in size and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-). The name cannot start with a special character.

descriptions.zh:
在使用本接口进行绑定之前，您需要先创建媒体Bucket。如果没有创建媒体Bucket，请先参见[添加媒体Bucket](~~42430~~)添加完成后，在调用本接口进行绑定。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation to bind an output media bucket to the media library, you must create a media bucket. For more information, see [Add media buckets](~~42430~~).

### QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 100 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~342832~~).
